name: Contil India Limited
summary: Contil India Limited operates in the investment sector and specializes in the international trade of food and grocery products. Its extensive product catalog encompasses a wide array of goods, including various spices, flours, cereals, pulses, beauty and cosmetic items, traditional Ayurvedic remedies, household articles and utensils, and a selection of branded merchandise. The company was established on October 26, 1994, and maintains its principal office in Baroda, India.
